definitions.gloss: funeral hall; funeral parlor; funeral home
definitions.explanation: A facility where funeral services and ceremonies are held. May include spaces for the wake, the funeral ceremony, and sometimes cremation.

examples.japanese: {葬儀場|そうぎじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I confirmed the location of the funeral hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{葬儀場|そうぎじょう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: There is a bus running from the station to the funeral hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家族葬|かぞくそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{葬儀場|そうぎじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, small funeral halls catering to family-only funerals have been increasing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧ (funeral ceremony) and {場|じょう} (place, hall). This is one of several terms for funeral-related facilities in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {葬儀場|そうぎじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧ — to reserve a funeral hall
- {葬儀場|そうぎじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ — to gather at the funeral hall
- {葬儀場|そうぎじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ — funeral hall parking lot
- ⟦{民間|みんかん}→民間：13260_minkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葬儀場|そうぎじょう} — private funeral hall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {斎場|さいじょう} — funeral facility (formal term, often refers to public/municipal facilities; can include crematoriums)
- {葬儀会館|そうぎかいかん} — funeral ceremony hall (often the marketing name used by funeral companies)
- {告別式場|こくべつしきじょう} — farewell ceremony venue (specifically for the farewell portion of the funeral)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Most Japanese funerals today are held at dedicated {葬儀場|そうぎじょう} rather than at home or at temples. The typical sequence involves an ⟦{通夜|つや}→通夜：16026_tsuya⟧ (wake) on the evening before, followed by the ⟦{告別式|こくべつしき}→告別式：05923_kokubetsushiki⟧ (farewell ceremony) the next day, and then ⟦{火葬|かそう}→火葬：13379_kasou⟧ (cremation) at a {火葬場|かそうば}.
